questions.question: How should the currency be shown next to amounts?

options.label: Currency code
options.adds: Show it as the ISO code after the amount, for example 12.50 USD.

options.label: Currency symbol
options.adds: Show it as the symbol before the amount, for example $12.50.

options.label: Separate column
options.adds: Show it in its own column or field, separate from the amount.
